site.name: Steep Creek, Mendenhall Glacier Recreation Area, Tongass National Forest
site.projection: EPSG:32608, game origin 526511 E, 6477009 N; x east and z south
site.surface_datum: NAVD88 minus 18 metres; local dry-ground registration 2013 alt +2023 correction −0.82212448 m

terrain_2023.source: USGS 3DEP Alaska Southeast Landslides, project D22
terrain_2023.use: Public US government elevation data, terrain and bank survey

point_cloud_2013.source: 2013–2014 NOAA/City and Borough of Juneau LiDAR
point_cloud_2013.collection: 2013-05-22 in the two tile records used
point_cloud_2013.use: NOAA lists no access restrictions. It documents possible TIN interpolation under closed vegetation and water-edge breaklines across open water. Classified colorized returns and dry-ground registration.

geography.use: USFS existing trail and Alaska AWC public mapped stream, observed fish habitat.

photo_validation.city_published_acquisition: City 2023 urban three-inch imagery and six-inch surrounding-area imagery. Source catalogs May 16 and June 18 flights.
photo_validation.use: Reference photos and city ortho checked for physical structure and seasonal habitat. No reference photographs are shipped.

inferences: Submerged creek and pond beds and individual cobble positions.
Height and crown form separation, species labels assigned from representative local canopy; no tree species inventory for each crown.
Fish skin/behavior/positions are native Aerie models, no telemetry; representative simulated run.
Multiple acquisition dates. Water and vegetation evolve seasonally.

materials.survey_to_runtime: Dry low-return color and vegetation-classed heights select the location of short understory communities. Existing Aerie ground scan and near photographed plant assets supply visual fine detail.
materials.external_scans: Original CC0 photographic material names and links are in game/field-ground-credits.txt.
materials.plant_representations: Ground cover uses the native Aerie summer grasses, sedges, forbs and scrub. Individual plant species and positions are inferred.
